basic_info.description: This home is new Construction (circa 2015). It is so rare to have a huge North Facing backyard drenched in sun. This View Home rests on a flat block of Greenwich next to Lyon Street, the Presidio park and George Lucas' Letterman Center. It's so unique to have panoramic views from Master Bedroom and yet be on a flat block. This Trophy residence features an open entertainment space and has one of the most dramatic wine atriums. You will love the Calacatta Gold marble countertops that make this kitchen a dream. There is an elevator and 1 to 2 car parking (size). The gallery style walls allow this home to be an art collector's dream. The master suite has a 5-Star luxury Spa-Like bath. This is the best Value for a view in Cow Hollow / Pacific Heights.
